questions.prompt: Which conflict was ended by the Treaty of Portsmouth in 1905?
questions.fact: It was the first modern war in which an Asian power defeated a European one, and it shocked capitals worldwide.

questions.prompt: What is the term for the tendency of a liquid to resist flow?
questions.fact: A pitch drop experiment running since 1927 has produced fewer than ten drops, demonstrating extreme viscosity.

questions.prompt: In swimming, which stroke is the fastest?
questions.fact: Freestyle technically allows any stroke, and everyone swims front crawl because it is fastest.

questions.prompt: Which television series features the character Ted Lasso?
questions.fact: The character began as a promotional advert for football coverage, years before the series existed.

questions.prompt: Which US state contains Death Valley?
questions.fact: It recorded the highest reliably measured air temperature on Earth, above 56 degrees Celsius.

questions.prompt: Which novel is set during the Spanish Civil War and features Robert Jordan?
questions.fact: Its title comes from a John Donne meditation, which also supplies the line about no man being an island.

questions.prompt: Which company created the Prometheus monitoring system?
questions.fact: It was later donated to a foundation and became a standard component of container infrastructure.
